punchline: Hope Jahren called her bipolar disorder a physiological illness with treatments, and said her experiences of it were still very real to her.
thirty_sec: Hope Jahren spent her career measuring plants and soil. In her memoir Lab Girl, she wrote for the first time about her episodes of mania and bipolar disorder. She told Time she sees it as a physiological illness, one with treatments and medication, and that the experiences were still very real to her. She says what it is, that it can be treated, and that it was real, without apology or drama.
